description: Source code for the connect_udp_tunnel component in the quiche QUIC library, implementing UDP tunnel over HTTP/3 with request validation, socket management, and datagram handling.

classes.name: ConnectUdpTunnel
classes.description: Manages a UDP tunnel over HTTP/3, handling request validation, socket communication, and datagram processing.

methods.name: OpenTunnel
methods.description: Initiates the UDP tunnel based on HTTP/3 request headers, performing validation and socket setup.

methods.name: IsTunnelOpenToTarget
methods.description: Checks if the tunnel to the target socket is active.

methods.name: OnClientStreamClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the client stream is closed.

methods.name: ConnectComplete
methods.description: Callback for connection completion; not expected to be called asynchronously.

methods.name: ReceiveComplete
methods.description: Handles data received from the target socket and forwards it to the client.

methods.name: SendComplete
methods.description: Callback for send completion; not expected to be called asynchronously.

methods.name: OnHttp3Datagram
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP/3 datagrams and sends UDP packets to the target.

methods.name: BeginAsyncReadFromTarget
methods.description: Starts asynchronous read from the target socket.

methods.name: SendUdpPacketToTarget
methods.description: Sends a UDP packet to the target via the socket.

methods.name: SendConnectResponse
methods.description: Sends a successful connection response to the client.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response to the client with details.

methods.name: TerminateClientStream
methods.description: Terminates the client stream with an error code and message.
